Lina Gomez: Noticed a tricky mobile a11y bug on the console: using VoiceOver rotor, the table rows are announced but the inline action buttons (ellipsis) are not reachable via touch explore. They seem to be aria-hidden when collapsed. Ethan Park: Hmm, that sounds like we hide actions visually for small widths. Are we using aria-hidden or display:none? Lina Gomez: We use `aria-hidden="true"` on the action wrapper when collapsed to prevent clutter. But VoiceOver on iOS still reads the row as "group" and you can't drill into the actions. Maya Patel: If the buttons are interactive, they must be accessible. aria-hidden shouldn't be used if the controls are needed. Consider moving the actions into an offscreen dialog that can be invoked, or provide a persistent accessible toggle that exposes the actions in the accessibility tree. Ethan Park: Agreed. For mobile condensed rows we should switch pattern: leave controls in DOM but visually hide with `opacity:0;height:0` is still bad. Better to keep them visible to SR and use `sr-only` styles to show to assistive tech. Sasha Lee: Another wrinkle: when using external Bluetooth keyboard + iPad Safari, tabbing skips over the inline buttons entirely. Keyboard users expect a logical order: row -> actions -> details. We must ensure `tabindex` order matches visual order. Lina Gomez: Proposed changes: 1) Remove aria-hidden from action wrapper. 2) Add `sr-only` text labels for icon buttons like
``` And toggle `hidden` -> remove attribute and set `aria-expanded=true` when opened. Maya Patel: Make sure menu items are reachable by VoiceOver rotor and iOS keyboard. For iOS, role=menu isn't always perfect; safe fallback is a simple dialog with role=dialog and list of buttons. Dialog has clearer behavior on VoiceOver. Sasha Lee: Good call. Dialog pattern is more consistent on mobile. If using dialog, ensure `aria-modal=true`, focus the dialog heading, and restore focus to trigger on close. Include `inert` on background content so keyboard/VO can't move outside while open. a11y-bot: Auto-scan: `aria-hidden` on .row-actions flagged (issue: blocks access) ❌; icon buttons missing accessible names ❌; keyboard focus order not linear ⚠️. Report: https://redwood-internal/a11y/2034506789 Lina Gomez: I'll open a small PR to: change `aria-hidden` -> keep in DOM; add sr-only labels; implement dialog fallback for mobile; add Playwright keyboard test simulating Bluetooth keyboard on iOS (approx using desktop emulation) and a manual VoiceOver iOS test checklist. Ethan Park: Also verify in high-contrast and large-text settings. Focus rings must remain visible: don't rely on 1px hairline outlines. Use 3px solid token. Maya Patel: Thanks — please add screenshots of VoiceOver rotor before/after to PR and a short video clip if possible. Tag @eng-runtime if we need an `inert` polyfill rolled out. Sasha Lee: One last note: add aria-describedby on rows that have status chips so screen readers announce the chip text inline, e.g., aria-describedby="row-42-status". Lina Gomez: Great. I'll push the PR and include the QA steps. Thanks all!
